judgments.reason: The phrase 'a left pyriform fossa mass' appears literally in the nasoendoscopy findings and directly supports localizing the hypopharyngeal cancer to the left pyriform fossa.

The phrase 'a large necrotic mass centred on the left pyriform fossa' appears literally in the MRI findings and clinically supports the anatomical modifier identifying the left pyriform fossa as the primary site.

The phrase 'high metabolic activity in the hypopharyngeal mass' appears literally in the PET-CT findings and supports the diagnosis of hypopharyngeal cancer, though it is less specific to the left pyriform fossa subsite than M001/M002.
